app.name: Youth IdeaLab
app.tagline: From first idea to final showcase, in 4 steps.

home.intro: Students explore, choose a real problem, build their answer to it and present it at Demo Day — with a mentor at every step.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Welcome back to Youth IdeaLab.
login.adultIntro: We'll email you a secure sign-in link. No password needed.
login.checkEmailBody: If this email is registered with us, a sign-in link is on its way. It works once and expires in one hour. Can't find it? Check your spam folder, or ask us on WhatsApp.
login.studentIntro: Use the username and password your parent set up for you.
login.forgotStudent: Forgot your password? Ask your parent — they can set a new one for you.
login.linkExpired: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Please ask for a new one.

addChild.title: Add your child
addChild.intro: Create your child's account. They'll sign in with the username and password you choose here — no email needed.
addChild.usernameHint: 3–30 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, dots or underscores.
addChild.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Only you can change it later.
addChild.consent: I am this child's parent or guardian. I agree to Youth IdeaLab storing their name, year of birth and project work as described in the <link>privacy and safeguarding notice</link>.
addChild.created: Account created. Share the username and password with your child.

errors.notAllowed: Only parents can add a child.
errors.usernameInvalid: Usernames are 3–30 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, dots or underscores, starting with a letter or number.
errors.usernameTaken: That username is taken. Please choose another.
errors.passwordShort: The password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.birthYearInvalid: Please check the year of birth. The course is for ages 12–18.
errors.consentRequired: Please confirm your consent to continue.
errors.createFailed: Something went wrong creating the account. Please try again.

errors.notAllowed: You can only change your own child's password.
errors.passwordShort: The password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.resetFailed: The password couldn't be changed. Please try again.

intro.student: Your weekly activities and your project will appear here.
intro.parent: Your child's progress will appear here.
intro.mentor: Your group, students' submissions and progress cards will appear here.
intro.admin: Groups, invitations and activities will be managed here.

comingSoon.body: This page is being built and will be ready before the first group starts.

privacy.title: Privacy and safeguarding
privacy.draft: Draft — this notice is being reviewed and may change before the first group starts.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: Your child's name, year of birth, username, the work they submit (text, files and links), and mentor feedback. For parents: name and email address. We don't collect your child's email address, phone number or photo unless they upload one as part of their project.

use.title: How we use it
use.body: Only to run the course: to show activities, collect and review project work, and send you weekly progress cards. We never sell data or use it for advertising.

see.title: Who can see it
see.body: Your child, you, your child's mentors and Youth IdeaLab staff. Other students and parents cannot see your child's work. A portfolio page is only made public if you give separate permission, and you can withdraw it at any time.

never.title: Safeguarding
never.body: All communication with students happens in moderated group spaces — never private messages. Every change to your child's records is logged.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can ask for a copy of everything we hold about your child, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete your child's account and data.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Youth IdeaLab is run by MetaFront LLP, Islamabad. Contact us on WhatsApp with any questions about your child's data.
